items.label: VexStream Mobile Library
items.purpose: Make VexStream on Android a durable, reusable and human-navigable mobile music library: preserve exact media identity and truthful download semantics while giving listeners coherent browse, sort/filter, and whole-Songs download management, with persistent sync separately governed.

items.label: Durable Device Music Library
items.purpose: Give verified VexStream media one durable Android device-library home that can survive VexLife app-data clearing and be rediscovered as reusable music.

items.label: Durable device music storage
items.purpose: Establish the Android-native durable media-storage realization while preserving exact trackRef, SHA-256 and byte-length verification.

items.label: Existing-download rediscovery
items.purpose: Let a fresh VexLife Android state reconstruct verified local-copy truth from durable VexStream media instead of treating the app-private index as the only memory of downloads.

items.label: Clear-data durability lived proof
items.purpose: Prove downloaded music survives VexLife Clear Data, is rediscovered after relaunch, and plays without redownloading.

items.label: Existing private-download migration
items.purpose: Define and implement a bounded path for already verified app-private VexStream downloads to enter durable device-library storage without duplication or partial/corrupt promotion.

items.label: Contextual Download Experience
items.purpose: Make existing one-shot VexStream download intent reachable from the listener's current music context with truthful missing counts and phone-constrained presentation, without creating another download engine.

items.label: Songs missing-content update / remove all
items.purpose: From VexStream settings, let the listener run one deliberate library-wide missing-content update: refresh the current paired Desktop catalog, download only exact currently missing eligible songs, and reconcile admitted artwork that is missing locally for existing or newly downloaded songs, while preserving catalog truth and never redownloading audio merely because artwork is absent. Remove all downloaded songs remains the separate destructive local-copy action. This is one-shot reconciliation, not persistent Keep Offline / background sync.

items.label: Library Browse & Discovery
items.purpose: Give listeners one coherent way to order and narrow current VexStream library truth into useful listening sets while catalog, collection, playback, and classification truth keep their rightful owners.

items.label: Sort / Filter / Recently added library controls
items.purpose: Present one compact VexStream library organization surface that keeps Sort by, Filter by, Search and freshness discovery distinct while making visible rows plus row playback / Play All / Shuffle All consume the same current organized membership. Lived feedback requires a truthful way to find fresh music: 'added to the VexStream catalog' and 'downloaded to this Android device' are separate clocks and must not be collapsed into one misleading Recently added label.

items.label: MassDownload Maturity
items.purpose: Keep accepted MassDownload product source and terminal EndToEnd proof as completed truth while the independently owned Queue/Track-menu intermittency remains visible as open causal work.

items.label: MassDownload product implementation
items.purpose: Preserve the accepted one-shot collection Download missing implementation as completed predecessor truth without relabelling it as persistent sync.

items.label: MassDownload terminal EndToEnd
items.purpose: Preserve the terminal accepted three-track MassDownload EndToEnd outcome across Android and SDK proof ownership without absorbing the separate Queue/Track-menu incident.

items.label: Track-menu presentation intermittency
items.purpose: Preserve the still-unexplained historical Add-to-queue / Track-menu intermittency after eight fresh accepted-current Queue evaluations produced eight passes and zero matching recurrence; pause foreground causal execution at this checkpoint and resume on matching recurrence or materially new causal evidence.

items.label: Persistent Keep Offline / Sync
items.purpose: Preserve the future policy question of keeping an album, artist, playlist, or other collection continuously mirrored as producer membership changes, without conflating it with one-shot Download missing.

items.label: User tag topology / dynamic stations
items.purpose: Preserve the future product question of user-authored music tags that remain distinct from imported source tags/categories and can drive reusable dynamic stations or smart-playlist rules without pre-deciding identity attachment, persistence ownership, rule language, or playlist materialization.

items.label: Large offline library cold-start performance
items.purpose: Resolve the 785-song Android cold-launch defect without weakening local-media integrity: the integrity-preserving source correction is merged, and the remaining obligation is Victor's lived current-main startup observation while broader cross-feature scalability/SCAE review remains separate.

items.label: Playback surfaces
items.purpose: Evolve VexStream's Android listening surfaces from the accepted mini-player into a full current-player experience that reuses Playback, Queue and Repeat semantic owners while remaining a presentation/navigation outcome rather than a second playback runtime.

items.label: Now Playing artwork projection
items.purpose: Carry optional current-track artwork from VexStream's canonical library metadata into the sanitized Android mobile catalog and Media3 MediaItem metadata so player/widget surfaces can render artwork when it is actually available without inventing Android-local artwork truth.

items.label: VexStream full player
items.purpose: Add one full-height Android Now Playing modal bottom sheet that expands from the current mini-player and composes current Playback, Queue and Repeat State/Control/Act/Effect owners: optional artwork, title/artist, previous/play-pause/next, shuffle/repeat, progress, large horizontal previous/next gestures, and an in-sheet Queue view/reveal without creating a second player or queue truth owner.

items.label: Offline artwork durability
items.purpose: Fix the observed Android experience where downloaded/local-only VexStream songs lose available cover art across restart or render generic placeholders: persist the admitted artwork source, keep a bounded app-private companion image for downloaded media, prefer local artwork in track/full-player presentation, and preserve audio integrity as independent truth.

items.label: Current-track artwork availability and convergence
items.purpose: Fix the lived playback-surface gap where the Full Player and home-screen widget still show generic artwork placeholders even after the embedded-artwork Desktop producer and Android consumer were accepted and merged. Distinguish tracks that genuinely have no admitted artwork from tracks whose known artwork source failed to reach/cache/project into current playback; make current admitted artwork converge without making the widget an artwork fetcher or changing media identity, and expose the per-track truth needed by a separate user-invoked missing-artwork reconciliation path.

items.label: VexStream pairing reconnect continuity across new builds
items.purpose: Fix the lived regression where installing a newer VexLife Android build can leave the phone unable to reconnect to the Desktop's already-established VexStream pairing. Preserve pairing across ordinary data-preserving upgrades/reinstalls, distinguish product persistence from destructive test/install tooling, and keep explicit Clear Data/uninstall credential loss separate from durable downloaded-media recovery.

items.label: VexStream pairing continuity after uninstall / reinstall
items.purpose: Explore a future explicit product design for reconnecting the same previously-approved Desktop after a true Android uninstall/reinstall removes app-private SharedPreferences and Android Keystore identity. Keep this separate from ordinary data-preserving upgrades/proof builds, do not weaken TLS pinning or bearer-token authority, and treat it as non-blocking experience backlog until deliberately resumed.

items.label: Reconcile / sync missing artwork
items.purpose: Provide a deliberate user-invoked reconciliation path for artwork that is missing locally even though the current VexStream/Android truth admits an artwork source. Classify the current library into known-artwork-present, known-artwork-missing/stale, and genuinely-no-artwork; fetch/cache only the missing ancillary artwork through existing repository/producer owners; report bounded counts/progress/results; never redownload audio or make the Full Player/widget network owners. Keep this separate from persistent Keep Offline / Sync, which governs media membership rather than artwork metadata.
